result.summary: This is a scripted-diff PR that mechanically adds `#include <util/check.h>` to test, fuzz, and bench files that use `assert`/`Assert`, and removes now-redundant `<cassert>` includes. A later commit re-sorts includes via clang-format, and a small lint script tweak allows clang-format to run inside scripted-diffs. The change is scoped only to test code; the author notes non-test code could follow later if needed.
result.problem: Developers writing test code are sometimes confused about whether assertions are affected by NDEBUG or whether to use assert vs Assert, and this confusion is compounded by inconsistent or missing includes of util/check.h, which also complicates running include-what-you-use (IWYU) tooling.

open_concerns: jeanpablojp noted the assert regex used by both the scripted-diff and lint_c_assert doesn't match cases with a space before the parenthesis, missing one file (src/test/fuzz/mini_miner.cpp).
jeanpablojp pointed out src/ipc/test/ is left out of the lint_cpp.rs path list even though it's part of the test suite and has several assert() calls.
resolved_concerns: A comma-placement bug in the lint_cpp.rs path list that caused the ipc test path to still match nothing was fixed by the author ('Whoops, fixed. Thx').

Author dropped the third and fourth commits (further assert-related changes) after finding they trip GCC codegen pessimization and conflict heavily with other open PRs, addressing his own earlier codegen concern.
